description: This file defines the ImplicitStreamPubSub class implementing IStreamPubSub for handling implicit pub/sub stream subscriptions within Orleans streaming infrastructure.

classes.name: ImplicitStreamPubSub
classes.description: Implements pub/sub management for implicit stream subscriptions using Orleans streaming infrastructure.

methods.name: RegisterProducer
methods.description: Registers a producer for a specified stream, returning current subscriptions.

methods.name: UnregisterProducer
methods.description: Unregisters a producer from a specified stream.

methods.name: RegisterConsumer
methods.description: Registers a consumer to a stream, supporting only implicit subscriptions.

methods.name: UnregisterConsumer
methods.description: Unregisters a consumer from a stream, supporting only implicit subscriptions.

methods.name: ProducerCount
methods.description: Returns the number of producers for a given stream (currently always 0).

methods.name: ConsumerCount
methods.description: Returns the number of consumers for a given stream (currently always 0).

methods.name: GetAllSubscriptions
methods.description: Retrieves all subscriptions for a given stream, optionally for a specific consumer.

methods.name: CreateSubscriptionId
methods.description: Creates a subscription ID based on stream and grain info, throws if subscription doesn't exist.

methods.name: FaultSubscription
methods.description: Attempts to fault (invalidate) a subscription, but currently always returns false.
